text:
Jordan: Quick ask — can someone run a short tail-latency variance sweep across H100 / A100 / L40S for the gpt2-like shape? Target seq=2048, batches 1/4/8. Need p50/p95/p99 + per-token throughput and a CSV artifact if possible. Trying to decide routing fallback thresholds.

Maya: I can kick this off on the bench farm. Which model repo + quantization?

Jordan: Use repo `rmodel/gpt2-structured` (v2). Quantization: bf16 runtime. No thin-batching for the first pass — want raw behavior.

Linh: Noted. I'll set kernel set to 1.2.3 and record kernel/driver versions in metadata. Any special flags?

Jordan: please also capture nvprof / trace for any p99 > 350ms. If p99 spikes only on one SKU, we need flamegraphs.

Ravi: quick run on H100 batch=1 completed — p50 120ms, p95 210ms, p99 430ms (we saw microburst around token ~1200). Uploading CSV now.

perf-bot: Run 1829123456-1 complete. Artifacts: s3://redwood-perf/runs/1829123456/h100/b1/results.csv and traces at s3://redwood-perf/runs/1829123456/h100/b1/traces.tar.gz

Maya: H100 p99 430ms is concerning. I'll re-run A100 and L40S with identical runtime flags. Re: microburst — could be kernel scheduling or power state transitions.

Linh: Starting perf trace on H100 with nvprof and `--dump-kv-cache` to correlate stalls. Command I'm running:
```
./bench.sh --model rmodel/gpt2-structured --seq 2048 --batch 1 --quant bf16 --kernel-set 1.2.3 --trace nvprof --out s3://redwood-perf/runs/1829123456/h100/b1/trace
```

Ravi: A100 batch=1 results landed: p50 110ms, p95 195ms, p99 375ms. Stable across 3 runs. L40S batch=1 p99 410ms but batch=8 shows better amortized throughput (p50 60ms/token).

Maya: Interesting — A100 looks more stable at batch=1. L40S seems to favor higher batch. This suggests routing policy could prefer A100 for low-batch, low-concurrency requests and L40S for high-batch throughput.

Jordan: Good. Can someone produce a 1-paragraph summary and list of concrete action items? Want to tag @eng-runtime-leads after that.

Maya: Summary: H100 shows occasional p99 microbursts at seq=2048, batch=1 (430ms). A100 is more stable (p99 ~375ms). L40S has higher p99 at low batch but better throughput at batch=8. Action items: 1) Linh to analyze nvprof traces and generate flamegraphs (due EOD), 2) Maya to run a kernel/driver variance test on H100 (next 24h), 3) Ravi to add benchmark artifacts + CSVs to the perf dashboard and tag models (done). If flamegraphs point to memcpy or kernel stall, consider adjusting thin-batch or prefetch knobs.

Linh: I'll upload flamegraphs to s3://redwood-perf/runs/1829123456/h100/b1/flamegraph.svg and post short notes when I find root cause.

Ravi: Added the CSVs and a short notebook comparing p99 across SKUs: s3://redwood-perf/notes/1829123456/sku-comparison.ipynb

Jordan: Nice — once Linh posts flamegraphs, let's decide whether to change default routing for seq>1024. Tagging follow-ups for weekly sync. Thanks all :thumbsup:

Maya: Ping me if you need queue priority bumped on the bench farm.

perf-bot: Reminder: bench farm allocation updated for eng-runtime; billing tag `bench-1829` applied.
